title: feat: launch app growth and established GitHub quests
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Launches `app_paid_request` when an external user makes a successful Paid Pollen request through a BYOP app: 15 Pollen.
- Launches `app_users_10` when an owner's apps reach ten distinct external users: 15 Pollen.
- Launches `github_established` for GitHub accounts at least 730 days old: 3 Pollen, keyed once per GitHub identity.
- Keeps `early_adopter` upcoming at nine months / 2 Pollen and `app_pollen_10` upcoming at 10 external Pollen / 25 Pollen.
- Adds a pinned Enter dashboard announcement linking users to the new quests.
- Excludes owner self-spend using the `byop_app_payer_daily` materialization and owner-scoped `quest_app_usage` endpoint.
- Bumps the combined quest catalog cache to `v26`.

Eligible today with external-payer semantics: `app_paid_request` 36 owners, `app_users_10` 40, `app_pollen_10` 10.

⚠️ Deploy `byop_app_payer_daily` and `quest_app_usage` to both Tinybird workspaces, including the materialization backfill, before the Worker ships. A missing endpoint fails the app-growth group and would also block its existing rewards.

Checks: `npx vitest run test/quests.test.ts` (30 passed), Enter frontend `tsc --noEmit`, Biome, and local `/news` + `/quests` browser verification.

Supersedes #12729.

gist.headline: Apps that bloom, earn
gist.blurb: A BYOP app getting real visitors is now a quest-worthy event. Bring in a paid request or ten distinct humans and the garden drops Pollen.
gist.summary: Added app-growth quests that award 15 Pollen for an external user's successful paid request (`app_paid_request`) and for reaching 10 distinct external users (`app_users_10`), plus a 3-Pollen `github_established` quest for GitHub accounts at least 730 days old.
gist.impact: BYOP builders can now earn rewards for real external app use without owner self-spend counting, while established GitHub contributors get a one-time identity-based Pollen reward.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tending a small app garden where a retro terminal-grown code plant has attracted ten friendly visitor sprites and produced glowing Pollen flowers. A tiny GitHub-style contribution calendar or aged developer badge sits beside the garden, while a dashboard notice board announces the new quests; the scene should make external users and healthy app growth feel tangible.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, black antennae, oval eyes, pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, light blue translucent wings, and a tiny gardener hat, watering a code-plant growing from a retro terminal while ten small friendly visitor sprites gather around its blooming Pollen flowers; an old GitHub contribution badge and a quest notice board sit nearby. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, flowers and vines, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, pixel-font text: "GROW & EARN", nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
